query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `team_members` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  `phone` varchar(20),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `user_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `agency_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `daily_standup_enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `smart_alerts_enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `weekly_strategy_enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `weekly_report_enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `account_invitations` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `token` varchar(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `email` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `first_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `last_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20),
  `company` varchar(255),
  `role` enum('super_admin','admin','agency_owner','client_user','loa') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'client_user',
  `agency_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `client_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','accepted','expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `invited_by_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `accepted_at` timestamp DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `contentAnalytics` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `contentId` int NOT NULL,
  `views` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `clicks` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `shares` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `engagementRate` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `avgTimeOnPage` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `conversions` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `recordedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
